text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
CORN SALE - Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group bought four 54,000-tonne shipments of U.S. No.2 corn at a tender on Friday, traders said.

WHEAT SALE - Philippine firms bought a total of 65,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat in the past two days after prices dropped due to prospects of better harvests in the United States this year, Manila grains traders said. A group of flour millers also sought tenders for the supply of an additional 35,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat today, they said.
WHEAT SALES - Norway has bought three shiploads of 3,000 tonnes each of European Union milling wheat for August shipment, German traders said.

VEGOIL SALE - El Salvador bought 3,000 tonnes of prime bleachable summer yellow cottonseed oil in bulk and 1,000 tonnes crude sunflowerseed oil under the PL-480 Title I export program, its U.S. export agent said.
WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan around August 27 will seek about 350,000 tonnes of optional origin soft white wheat for September 11-October 10 delivery, a Pakistan embassy official said.
WHEAT TENDERS - Georgia on August 20 seeks two cargoes of up to 65,000 tonnes each of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL-480 export program, its U.S. shipping agent said.
One cargo of up to 65,000 tonnes was slated for September 10-30 delivery and another cargo of up to 65,000 tonnes was set for November 10-30 delivery.
- South Africa's North-West Co-operative Ltd said Friday its tender for 34,650 tonnes of yellow maize had been passed.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC was seeking up to 7,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better Northern Spring/Dark Northern spring wheat under its export program for donation to Nicaragua.

VEGOIL TENDER - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries on August 19 seeks 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

VEGOILS - CCC will tender on August 18 to buy 3,945 tonnes of refined sunflowerseed oil for donation to Bosnia and Georgia, comprising 2,695 tonnes for Georgia and 1,250 tonnes for Bosnia. Shipment periods for both parcels are identical, with dates of Oct 6-20 for suppliers with inland plants or Oct 19-Nov 3 for suppliers with plants at ports.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery. September 1 was set as final date to receive bids. Results would be on Sept 8.
MARKET TALK - China imported 840,000 tonnes of wheat in the first half of the year, down 83 percent from the same period of 1996, according to customs figures made available on Friday.
